content:
The story describes Zhao Xiao as having excellent grades and a friendly attitude, which earns him appreciation from teachers and students. When Wang Ming shows his report card and expresses disappointment, Zhao Xiao acknowledges that Wang Ming likely didn't study hard but still chooses to encourage him by saying the grades are "not bad" and that he can improve with more effort. This indicates Zhao Xiao is not genuinely believing the grades are good (as he suspects Wang Ming didn't study enough), but rather is intentionally offering encouragement. 

Option A is incorrect because Zhao Xiao explicitly thinks Wang Ming "probably does not study hard," meaning he doesn't truly believe the grades are acceptable. Option B is unsupported, as the story never mentions Zhao Xiao being elected class representative or any motive related to image-building. Option D is implausible since Zhao Xiao is described as having "excellent grades," and there's no indication he is dissatisfied with his own performance. 

Option C aligns best with Zhao Xiao's known friendly attitude and the context of the situation. His encouragement is clearly intended to uplift Wang Ming and preserve a positive, supportive dormitory environment, which fits his character as described. 

[[C]]
STORY: Zhao Xiao receives love from teachers and students because of his excellent grades and friendly attitude. One day, his roommate Wang Ming feels depressed because of his unsatisfactory final exam results. Wang Ming shows his report card to Zhao Xiao, asking Zhao Xiao what he thinks of his grades. After seeing the report card, although Zhao Xiao thinks Wang Ming probably does not study hard, he still encourages Wang Ming, saying the grades are not bad, and as long as he works a little harder, he can improve.
QUESTION: Why does Zhao Xiao say this?
OPTION-A: Zhao Xiao says this because he really thinks Wang Ming's grades are not bad, he just needs to work harder.
OPTION-B: Zhao Xiao just gets elected as the class representative, he answers this way to establish an image of supporting and encouraging classmates.
OPTION-C: Zhao Xiao says this because he wants to encourage Wang Ming, and maintain their friendly relationship and the harmonious atmosphere of the dormitory.
OPTION-D: Zhao Xiao is also dissatisfied with the exam, he says these to cover up his own sense of disappointment.
